tasks.subject: Task 1: Restructure Container padding + add stickyHeader
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Move Container's padding onto new Header/ContentArea children (no visual change), then make the header row stickable via a new `stickyHeader` prop (default false).

**Files:**
- Modify: src/Modal/Modal.tsx
- Modify: src/Modal/Modal.test.tsx
- Modify (regenerated): src/Modal/__snapshots__/Modal.test.tsx.snap

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Modal renders identically (visually) with default props
- [ ] stickyHeader defaults to false; true applies position:sticky;top:0 to header
- [ ] All tests pass

**Verify:** npx vitest run src/Modal/Modal.test.tsx

tasks.subject: Task 2: Add footer + stickyFooter
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add an optional `footer` slot rendered below the scrollable content, with opt-in `stickyFooter`, and a default flex layout (1 child fills row, 2 children split 50/50) matching the Figma reference.

**Files:**
- Modify: src/Modal/Modal.tsx
- Modify: src/Modal/Modal.test.tsx
- Modify (regenerated): src/Modal/__snapshots__/Modal.test.tsx.snap

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Omitting footer renders nothing extra
- [ ] footer renders flex row, gap theme.space[100], children flex:1, border-top 1px solid theme.color.border.subtle
- [ ] stickyFooter defaults false; true applies position:sticky;bottom:0
- [ ] All tests pass

**Verify:** npx vitest run src/Modal/Modal.test.tsx

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Modal/Modal.tsx", "src/Modal/Modal.test.tsx", "src/Modal/__snapshots__/Modal.test.tsx.snap"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run src/Modal/Modal.test.tsx", "acceptanceCriteria": ["footer omitted renders nothing extra", "footer flex layout with gap and flex:1 children plus divider border-top", "stickyFooter defaults false, true sticks footer to bottom", "check-types and lint pass"]}
```
